_comment: Minecraft Multiversion egg. The startup logic lives in the container entrypoint, not here.
name: Minecraft Multiversion
author: legendofzeldacartoon@gmail.com
description: A single egg for every Java Minecraft server. The container entrypoint detects at boot whether the installed software is Vanilla, Paper, Purpur, Spigot, Forge, NeoForge, Fabric, Quilt, Velocity, BungeeCord or Waterfall, and builds the right startup command for it. Because detection reads what is on disk, an external installer module can swap the software at any time without changing the egg. Adds panel toggles for server.properties (online-mode, difficulty, view distance and more), JVM tuning, optional auto-update and pre-flight validation. REQUIRES the matching custom Docker images.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
#
# Install script for the Minecraft Multiversion egg.
# Runs in ghcr.io/pterodactyl/installers:alpine. Server files go to /mnt/server.
#
# This only has to place the initial files. The entrypoint detects whatever is
# on disk at boot, so an external installer module can replace the software at
# any time without touching the egg.
#
set -e

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

UA="pterodactyl-mc-multiversion/1.0 (+https://pterodactyl.io)"
fetch() { curl -sSL --fail --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -A "${UA}" "$@"; }

SOFTWARE=$(echo "${SERVER_SOFTWARE:-paper}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
VERSION="${SERVER_VERSION:-latest}"
CHANNEL="${UPDATE_CHANNEL:-STABLE}"
JARFILE="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"

echo "=================================================="
echo " Software : ${SOFTWARE}"
echo " Version  : ${VERSION}"
echo " Jar file : ${JARFILE}"
echo "=================================================="

if [ "${SOFTWARE}" = "none" ]; then
    echo "SERVER_SOFTWARE is 'none'. Skipping download."
    echo "Use your installer module to place the server files."
    exit 0
fi

# --- PaperMC family (paper, folia, velocity, waterfall) --------------------
# api.papermc.io/v2 was shut down on 2026-07-01; everything goes through the
# Fill v3 API, which rejects requests without a descriptive User-Agent.
install_paper_family() {
    PROJECT="$1"

    # Released versions are preferred over in-development ones: Velocity's
    # newest entry is a -SNAPSHOT branch, and "latest" should not land there.
    # Filtering by build channel does not help, since snapshot versions still
    # publish their builds under the STABLE channel.
    if [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${VERSION}" ]; then
        VERSION=$(fetch "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}" | jq -r '
            [ .versions | to_entries[] | .value[] ] as $all
            | ( [ $all[] | select(test("-(SNAPSHOT|rc|pre)") | not) ][0] // $all[0] // empty )')
        echo "Resolved latest ${PROJECT} version: ${VERSION}"
    fi

    if [ -z "${VERSION}" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: could not resolve a version for ${PROJECT}." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    URL=$(fetch "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${VERSION}/builds" \
        | jq -r --arg ch "${CHANNEL}" '
            ( [ .[] | select(.channel == $ch) ][0] // .[0] ) as $b
            | if $b == null then empty else $b.downloads["server:default"].url end')

    if [ -z "${URL}" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: no builds found for ${PROJECT} ${VERSION}." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Downloading ${URL}"
    fetch -o "${JARFILE}" "${URL}"
}

# --- Purpur ----------------------------------------------------------------
install_purpur() {
    if [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${VERSION}" ]; then
        VERSION=$(fetch "https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur" | jq -r '.metadata.current // .versions[-1]')
        echo "Resolved latest Purpur version: ${VERSION}"
    fi

    echo "Downloading Purpur ${VERSION}"
    fetch -o "${JARFILE}" "https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur/${VERSION}/latest/download"
}

# --- Vanilla ---------------------------------------------------------------
install_vanilla() {
    MANIFEST="https://launchermeta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest.json"

    if [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${VERSION}" ]; then
        VERSION=$(fetch "${MANIFEST}" | jq -r '.latest.release')
    elif [ "${VERSION}" = "snapshot" ]; then
        VERSION=$(fetch "${MANIFEST}" | jq -r '.latest.snapshot')
    fi
    echo "Resolved Vanilla version: ${VERSION}"

    VERSION_URL=$(fetch "${MANIFEST}" | jq -r --arg v "${VERSION}" '.versions[] | select(.id == $v) | .url')
    if [ -z "${VERSION_URL}" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: Vanilla version ${VERSION} not found." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(fetch "${VERSION_URL}" | jq -r '.downloads.server.url')
    echo "Downloading ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
    fetch -o "${JARFILE}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
}

# --- Fabric ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Fabric publishes a ready-made launcher jar, so no installer run is needed.
install_fabric() {
    if [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${VERSION}" ]; then
        VERSION=$(fetch "https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/game" | jq -r '[.[] | select(.stable == true)][0].version')
    fi
    LOADER=$(fetch "https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader" | jq -r '[.[] | select(.stable == true)][0].version')
    INSTALLER=$(fetch "https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/installer" | jq -r '[.[] | select(.stable == true)][0].version')

    echo "Fabric: game ${VERSION}, loader ${LOADER}, installer ${INSTALLER}"
    fetch -o "${JARFILE}" \
        "https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader/${VERSION}/${LOADER}/${INSTALLER}/server/jar"
}

case "${SOFTWARE}" in
    paper|folia|velocity|waterfall) install_paper_family "${SOFTWARE}" ;;
    purpur)                         install_purpur ;;
    vanilla)                        install_vanilla ;;
    fabric)                         install_fabric ;;
    *)
        echo "ERROR: unknown SERVER_SOFTWARE '${SOFTWARE}'." >&2
        echo "Valid values: paper, folia, purpur, vanilla, fabric, velocity, waterfall, none" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

if [ ! -s "${JARFILE}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: ${JARFILE} is missing or empty after download." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Proxies have no EULA and no server.properties.
case "${SOFTWARE}" in
    velocity|waterfall) ;;
    *)
        if [ "${EULA}" = "true" ] || [ "${EULA}" = "1" ]; then
            echo "eula=true" > eula.txt
            echo "EULA accepted."
        fi
        [ -f server.properties ] || touch server.properties
        ;;
esac

echo "Downloaded $(du -h "${JARFILE}" | cut -f1) to ${JARFILE}"
echo "Install complete."

variables.name: Server Software
variables.description: Software to download on install/reinstall. Use "none" if an external installer module places the files. Valid: paper, folia, purpur, vanilla, fabric, velocity, waterfall, none.

variables.name: Server Version
variables.description: Minecraft version to install. "latest" picks the newest release, "snapshot" works for vanilla only. Only applied on install/reinstall.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: Name of the jar the server runs from. Ignored for Forge/NeoForge 1.17+, which launch from their args file instead.

variables.name: Server Type Override
variables.description: Force a server type instead of auto-detecting it. "auto" is almost always correct. Valid: auto, vanilla, forge, neoforge, fabric, quilt, velocity, bungeecord.

variables.name: Startup Mode
variables.description: "auto" builds the java command from the detected software and the toggles below (recommended). "manual" runs the Startup Command above verbatim, only injecting flags.

variables.name: Minimum Memory (MB)
variables.description: Value for -Xms. Leave at 128 unless you know you need otherwise.

variables.name: Extra Java Arguments
variables.description: Additional JVM flags appended to the command, space separated. Example: -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -XX:+UseStringDeduplication

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone for the JVM and container, e.g. UTC, America/Santiago, Europe/Madrid.

variables.name: Aikar's Flags
variables.description: Enable Aikar's G1GC tuning. Recommended for Paper/Purpur/Spigot. Velocity automatically gets its own recommended flag set instead.

variables.name: Garbage Collector
variables.description: Only used when Aikar's Flags is off. Valid: auto, g1, zgc, zgc-gen, shenandoah. ZGC needs Java 15+, zgc-gen needs Java 21+.

variables.name: Use MaxRAMPercentage
variables.description: Replace -Xmx with -XX:MaxRAMPercentage so the JVM leaves headroom for native memory. Helps with modpacks that get OOM-killed.

variables.name: Max RAM Percentage
variables.description: Heap percentage used when the option above is enabled.

variables.name: SIMD Operations
variables.description: Adds --add-modules=jdk.incubator.vector, used by Pufferfish/Purpur for faster math. Needs Java 16+ and is ignored otherwise.

variables.name: Log4j2 Mitigation
variables.description: Adds -Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true. Only useful on unpatched builds; update the server instead where possible.

variables.name: Online Mode
variables.description: Verify players against Mojang. Set to "auto" to leave server.properties untouched and manage it by hand. Also applied to velocity.toml / BungeeCord config.yml.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: peaceful, easy, normal, hard, or auto to leave it alone.

variables.name: Gamemode
variables.description: survival, creative, adventure, spectator, or auto.

variables.name: PvP
variables.description: true, false, or auto.

variables.name: Hardcore
variables.description: true, false, or auto.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Player slot limit, or auto.

variables.name: View Distance
variables.description: Chunk render distance (3-32), or auto. Lowering this is the single biggest performance win on a busy server.

variables.name: Simulation Distance
variables.description: Chunk tick distance (3-32), or auto.

variables.name: Max Tick Time
variables.description: Watchdog timeout in milliseconds. Use -1 to disable the watchdog on heavy modpacks, or auto.

variables.name: MOTD
variables.description: Server list message. Use auto to leave it alone. Colour codes with the section sign work.

variables.name: Whitelist
variables.description: true, false, or auto. Maps to white-list in server.properties.

variables.name: Enforce Secure Profile
variables.description: Requires signed chat (1.19+). Set to false for offline-mode or proxy backends, or auto.

variables.name: Level Seed
variables.description: World seed. Only takes effect on a fresh world. Use auto to leave it alone.

variables.name: Level Type
variables.description: World generator, e.g. minecraft:normal, minecraft:flat, minecraft:amplified, or auto.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Check for a newer build on every start. Only works for plain-jar software; Forge, NeoForge, Fabric and Quilt are skipped because updating them requires regenerating libraries/.

variables.name: Update Project
variables.description: What to update to. "auto" derives it from the detected software. Valid: auto, paper, folia, purpur, velocity, waterfall, vanilla.

variables.name: Update Minecraft Version
variables.description: Version to track when auto-updating. "latest" follows the newest release; pin a version to stay on it and only receive new builds.

variables.name: Update Channel
variables.description: PaperMC build channel: STABLE, RECOMMENDED, BETA or ALPHA. Falls back to the newest build if the channel has none.

variables.name: Pre-flight Validation
variables.description: Check before starting that the jar or args file exists, that the EULA is accepted, and that the image's Java version is new enough. Aborts with a readable message instead of a stack trace.

variables.name: Minecraft Version Hint
variables.description: Optional. Set this to the Minecraft version (e.g. 1.20.1) so the Java compatibility check works when it cannot be detected automatically.
